name: VTIM
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 描述车辆与板式轨道动力相互作用的模型。
usage_overview: 用于车辆与板式轨道的耦合动力分析。在考虑钢轨随机不平顺的模型中，可用于研究垂向动力相互作用；垂向分析是该类模型的具体应用方向。

complete_examples.text: The reliability and effectiveness of VTIM and CCM are validated by comparing with a more comprehensive 3-D model and the fixed-point excitation method.
In this paper, a more versatile VTIM is proposed by considering the discontinuity of track slabs, and a novel CCM is also developed to achieve the infinite length computations.
